description: On a sheet (id, number or name), crop a plan, elevation or section (drawing: its id from list_sheets) to box (two opposite corners) or shape (three or more points round the part to keep), given as model points: plan mm, with height (mm above the drawing's level) for elevations and sections, where x or y runs along the façade and height up it. uncrop shows it whole again. With detail, the box or shape is instead drawn again on the same sheet as an enlarged detail (scale, default about a quarter of the drawing's, e.g. 1:20 from 1:100; title, default Detail n), and the drawing shows a callout with its number.
name: crop_drawing
title: Crop a drawing or add an enlarged detail
